behaviors.source: GH #303 AC1, AC3, AC10; ADR 0020, ADR 0035
behaviors.given: a step promise that never settles, an injected now past the exit's origin plus MUTATION_STEP_BOUND_MS and a now inside the bound, and a rejecting guardian in each guardian mode with mutationNow past that exit's origin plus the bound
behaviors.when: each exit that awaits the step calls the one bounded-await helper with that one constant
behaviors.then: the helper calls terminate before resolving MUTATION_NOT_RUN with reason BOUND_REACHED past the bound and awaits the step inside it, the rejoin exit's origin is the post-fork instant both guardian results are in hand, terminate is bound to quiesceWorktree on reviewDir with no second kill path, and the rejection exit leaves with the guardian's own reason under the same bound rather than awaiting settlement — including when terminate itself throws and is swallowed
behaviors.observableResult: src/mutation-report.test.ts asserts the terminate-then-classify ordering and both clock cases; src/ship-gate.test.ts asserts the captured rejoin origin, the terminate binding, that the gate has not returned while the seam promise is pending, and that a rejection with a never-settling seam and a clock past the bound still leaves the gate
